SELECT classe, count(*) AS n, floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - min(computed_at))) / 86400) AS jours_max, floor(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - computed_at)) / 86400)) AS jours_median FROM parcel_au_statut GROUP BY classe

SELECT n FROM usage_compteurs WHERE jour = %(j)s AND sujet = %(s)s AND kind = 'fiche'

SELECT to_regclass('dryrun_parcel_evaluations')
SELECT 1 FROM dryrun_parcel_evaluations WHERE run_label = %(r)s LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.idu, p.commune, p.surface_m2, ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(p.geom_2975), 4326)) AS lat, ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(p.geom_2975), 4326)) AS lon, d.status AS status, d.completeness_score, -- M129-B : matrice morte (d.status IN ('exclue', 'faux_positif_probable')) AS etage0 FROM parcels p JOIN dryrun_parcel_evaluations d ON d.parcel_id = p.id AND d.run_label = %(run)s WHERE p.idu = %(idu)s
SELECT to_regclass('p_score_v2_runs')
SELECT run_id FROM p_score_v2_runs WHERE run_id = %(label)s LIMIT 1
SELECT tier, rang, mult_base, p_raw, percentile, copro, icd, icd_detail, top5_contributions FROM parcel_p_score_v2 WHERE run_id = %(r)s AND parcelle_id = %(idu)s
SELECT to_regclass('parcel_filtre_bati') IS NOT NULL
SELECT to_regclass('served_run_exceptions') IS NOT NULL
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'served_run_exceptions' AND column_name = 'motif_client')
SELECT to_regclass('parcel_zone_plu') IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.parcelle_id AS idu, s.tier, s.rang, rsd.sdp_residuelle_m2, zp.zone_fam AS zone_fam, zp.zone_lib AS zone_lib, fb.decision AS fb_decision, fb.ratio_pct AS fb_ratio, fb.motif AS fb_motif, ex.motif_client AS ex_motif_client, (ex.idu IS NOT NULL) AS ex_present FROM parcel_p_score_v2 s LEFT JOIN parcel_filtre_bati fb ON fb.idu = s.parcelle_id LEFT JOIN served_run_exceptions ex ON ex.run_id = s.run_id AND ex.idu = s.parcelle_id LEFT JOIN parcel_zone_plu zp ON zp.idu = s.parcelle_id LEFT JOIN parcels prc ON prc.idu = s.parcelle_id LEFT JOIN parcel_residuel rsd ON rsd.parcel_id = prc.id AND rsd.cause IS NULL WHERE s.run_id = %(run)s AND s.parcelle_id = ANY(%(idus)s)
SELECT count(*) FROM parcel_p_score_v2 WHERE run_id = %(r)s AND rang IS NOT NULL

SELECT cr.layer_name, cr.result, cr.severity, cr.weight_applied, cr.detail, cr.source_table, cr.source_id, cr.evenement, cr.created_at, ds.name AS source, ds.source_millesime FROM dryrun_cascade_results cr LEFT JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id = cr.data_source_id WHERE cr.run_label = %(run)s AND cr.parcel_id = %(pid)s -- `cr.id` : tiebreaker DÉTERMINISTE — une couche peut émettre 2 lignes de même |poids| -- (ex. zonage mixte : « Zonage mixte… » + « Zone PLU U… », poids nul tous deux). Sans -- lui, l'ordre des ex æquo suivait l'ordre physique (heap) → un gros UPDATE de la table -- le rebattait. L'ordre d'émission (= id croissant) est stable et fixe le « premier ». ORDER BY abs(COALESCE(cr.weight_applied, 0)) DESC, cr.layer_name, cr.id
SELECT to_regclass('parcel_viabilisation') IS NOT NULL
SELECT voie10, voie75 FROM parcel_viabilisation WHERE idu = %(i)s
SELECT denomination, siren, groupe_label FROM parcelle_personne_morale WHERE idu = %(idu)s
SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_1
SELECT famille, max(date_annonce)::text AS d FROM bodacc_annonces_owner WHERE siren = %(s)s AND famille IN ('radiation','pcl') GROUP BY famille
RELEASE SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_1
SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_2
SELECT naf, adresse, commune, date_creation, actif, tranche_effectif FROM sirene_etablissements WHERE siren = %(s)s ORDER BY actif DESC NULLS LAST, date_creation ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
RELEASE SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_2

WITH unifie AS ( SELECT millesime, idu, siren, denomination, forme_juridique, groupe_label FROM pm_proprietaires_millesimes UNION ALL SELECT %(servi)s, idu, siren, denomination, forme_juridique, groupe_label FROM parcelle_personne_morale WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_proprietaires_millesimes WHERE millesime = %(servi)s) ) SELECT millesime, siren, denomination, forme_juridique, groupe_label FROM unifie WHERE idu = %(idu)s ORDER BY millesime
SELECT date_mutation, nature, valeur, prix_m2_bati, prix_m2_terrain, multi_parcelles FROM v_parcel_dvf_last WHERE idu = %(idu)s
SELECT type_bien, n_ventes, mediane_valeur, mediane_prix_m2, fenetre FROM dvf_secteur_medianes WHERE secteur = substring(%(idu)s FROM 1 FOR 10) ORDER BY n_ventes DESC
SELECT pente_moy_deg, pente_max_deg, flag_terrassement_lourd FROM parcel_terrain WHERE idu = %(idu)s

SELECT numero_immatriculation, nom_usage, adresse, nb_lots_total, nb_lots_habitation, periode_construction, syndic_type, syndic_nom, syndic_siret, rattachement, (raw->>'nombre_de_lots_de_stationnement')::int AS nb_lots_stationnement, raw->>'nombre_total_de_lots_a_usage_d_habitation_de_bureaux_ou_de_comm' AS nb_lots_hab_bur_com, raw->>'residence_service' AS residence_service, raw->>'syndicat_cooperatif' AS syndicat_cooperatif FROM rnic_coproprietes WHERE parcelle_idu = %(idu)s ORDER BY nb_lots_total DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT b.bien_id, b.statut, b.rattachement_niveau, f.prix, f.type_bien, a.portail, a.url_sortante FROM pige_biens b JOIN pige_faits f ON f.bien_id = b.bien_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT portail, url_sortante FROM pige_annonces WHERE bien_id = b.bien_id ORDER BY date_saisie DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true WHERE b.idu = %(idu)s AND f.valide_at IS NOT NULL AND b.statut IN ('active','en_vente_longue') ORDER BY b.date_derniere_confirmation DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.ind, f.men, f.men_pauv, f.men_prop, round((f.ind_snv / NULLIF(f.ind, 0))::numeric) AS nivvie_moyen_eur FROM filosofi_carreaux_200m f JOIN parcels p2 ON p2.idu = %(idu)s WHERE ST_Contains(f.geom, ST_Transform(p2.centroid, 2975)) LIMIT 1
SELECT nb_logements, construct_median, pct_qpv FROM rpls_commune WHERE insee = substring(%(idu)s FROM 1 FOR 5)
SELECT v_score, v_band, v_coverage, v_confidence, owner_type, owner_siren, owner_denomination, signals, computed_at FROM parcel_v_score WHERE parcelle_id = %(idu)s

SELECT a.name, a.attrs->>'interet' AS interet, ST_Intersects(p2.geom_2975, a.geom_2975) AS dans FROM spatial_layers a JOIN parcels p2 ON p2.idu = %(idu)s WHERE a.kind = 'anru' AND ST_DWithin(p2.geom_2975, a.geom_2975, 100) ORDER BY ST_Intersects(p2.geom_2975, a.geom_2975) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM parcels WHERE idu = %(idu)s

SELECT d.mutation_id AS mid, d.valeur_fonciere AS val, d.surface_reelle_bati AS surf, d.valeur_fonciere / d.surface_reelle_bati AS prix, CASE WHEN d.type_local ILIKE '%%APPARTEMENT%%' THEN 'appartement' ELSE 'maison' END AS cat, (d.nature_mutation ILIKE '%%futur%%') AS vefa, extract(year FROM d.date_mutation)::int AS annee, round(ST_Distance(d.geom::geography, p.centroid::geography)) AS dist FROM dvf_mutations d, parcels p WHERE p.id = %(pid)s AND d.commune = p.commune AND d.surface_reelle_bati >= 20 AND d.valeur_fonciere > 20000 AND d.nature_mutation ILIKE '%%vente%%' AND d.type_local ILIKE ANY(ARRAY['%%APPARTEMENT%%','%%MAISON%%'])
SELECT to_regclass('adresses') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('adresse_parcelles') IS NOT NULL

SELECT trim(concat_ws(' ', a.numero, a.rep, a.voie)) AS voie, a.code_postal AS cp, a.commune AS com FROM adresse_parcelles ap JOIN adresses a ON a.id_ban = ap.id_ban WHERE ap.idu = %(idu)s ORDER BY (ap.source = 'principal') DESC, (a.numero IS NULL), NULLIF(regexp_replace(a.numero, '\D', '', 'g'), '')::int NULLS LAST, a.id_ban LIMIT 1
SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_3
SELECT n_parcelles FROM p_score_v2_runs WHERE run_id = %(r)s
RELEASE SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_3
SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_4
SELECT to_regclass('source_veille') IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT ds.name, ds.category, ds.provider, ds.source_millesime, ds.source_horizon_at, ds.reliability_level, sv.dernier_vu, ds.last_sync_at FROM dryrun_cascade_results cr JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id = cr.data_source_id LEFT JOIN source_veille sv ON sv.source_id = ds.id WHERE cr.run_label = %(run)s AND cr.parcel_id = %(pid)s ORDER BY ds.category, ds.name
RELEASE SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_4

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(rtrim(split_part(btrim(sl.attrs->>'libelle'), ' ', 1), ':'), ''), rtrim(split_part(btrim(sl.name), ' ', 1), ':')) AS zone, max(sl.attrs->>'libelle') AS libelle, max(sl.attrs->>'idurba') AS idurba, sum(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(sl.geom_2975, p.geom_2975))) / NULLIF(max(ST_Area(p.geom_2975)), 0) AS part FROM spatial_layers sl JOIN parcels p ON p.idu = %(idu)s WHERE sl.kind = 'plu_gpu_zone' AND ST_Intersects(sl.geom_2975, p.geom_2975) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY part DESC NULLS LAST
SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_5
SELECT permit_id, type, date::date::text AS date_autorisation, date_depot::date::text AS date_depot FROM sitadel_permits WHERE idu_codes ? %(idu)s ORDER BY COALESCE(date_depot, date) DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT pc_annee, caduc_depuis, statut_autorisation, statut_caducite, libelle_court, detail FROM pc_caducs WHERE idu = %(idu)s
RELEASE SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_5
SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_6

WITH a AS (SELECT geom_2975 AS g FROM parcels WHERE idu = %(idu)s), since AS (SELECT (now() - interval '36 months')::date AS d) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM dvf_mutations_parcelle m JOIN parcels dp ON dp.idu = m.id_parcelle, a, since WHERE m.date_mutation >= since.d AND m.id_parcelle <> %(idu)s AND ST_DWithin(a.g, dp.geom_2975, 100)) AS n_dvf, (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.valeur_fonciere) FROM dvf_mutations_parcelle m JOIN parcels dp ON dp.idu = m.id_parcelle, a, since WHERE m.date_mutation >= since.d AND m.id_parcelle <> %(idu)s AND m.valeur_fonciere > 0 AND ST_DWithin(a.g, dp.geom_2975, 100)) AS prix_median, (SELECT count(*) FROM sitadel_permits p, a, since WHERE p.geom_2975 IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.date_depot, p.date) >= since.d AND NOT (p.idu_codes ? %(idu)s) AND ST_DWithin(a.g, p.geom_2975, 100)) AS n_permis
RELEASE SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_6

SELECT p.id AS pid, r.pct_potentiel, r.sdp_residuelle_m2, r.sous_densite, r.capacite_estimee, zp.zone_fam, zp.zone_lib FROM parcels p LEFT JOIN parcel_residuel r ON r.parcel_id = p.id AND r.cause IS NULL LEFT JOIN parcel_zone_plu zp ON zp.idu = p.idu WHERE p.idu = %(idu)s

SELECT p.idu, p.commune, ST_Area(p.geom_2975) AS surface_m2, (SELECT max((pl.attrs->>'slope_pct')::float) FROM spatial_layers pl WHERE pl.commune = p.commune AND pl.kind = 'pente' AND ST_Intersects(pl.geom_2975, p.geom_2975)) AS pente_pct, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM spatial_layers t WHERE t.commune = p.commune AND t.kind = 'trait_de_cote' AND t.subtype IN ('bande_courte','bande_longue') AND ST_Intersects(t.geom_2975, p.geom_2975)) AS littoral, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM spatial_layers a WHERE a.commune = p.commune AND a.kind = 'safer' AND ST_Intersects(a.geom_2975, p.geom_2975)) AS safer FROM parcels p WHERE p.id = %(pid)s
SELECT to_regclass('parcel_zone_plu') IS NOT NULL
SELECT zp.zone_lib, zp.zone_fam FROM parcel_zone_plu zp JOIN parcels p ON p.idu = zp.idu WHERE p.id = %(pid)s

SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(rtrim(split_part(btrim(z.attrs->>'libelle'), ' ', 1), ':'), ''), rtrim(split_part(btrim(z.name), ' ', 1), ':'))) AS n, min(COALESCE(NULLIF(rtrim(split_part(btrim(z.attrs->>'libelle'), ' ', 1), ':'), ''), rtrim(split_part(btrim(z.name), ' ', 1), ':'))) AS zone, min(CASE WHEN z.subtype ILIKE 'AU%%' THEN 'AU' WHEN z.subtype ILIKE 'U%%' THEN 'U' WHEN z.subtype = 'A' THEN 'A' WHEN z.subtype = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'autre' END) AS fam FROM spatial_layers z, (SELECT geom_2975 AS g FROM parcels WHERE id = %(pid)s) p WHERE z.kind = 'plu_gpu_zone' AND ST_Intersects(z.geom_2975, p.g)

WITH p AS (SELECT geom_2975 AS g, ST_Area(geom_2975) AS a FROM parcels WHERE id = %(pid)s) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(rtrim(split_part(btrim(z.attrs->>'libelle'), ' ', 1), ':'), ''), rtrim(split_part(btrim(z.name), ' ', 1), ':')) AS zone, CASE WHEN z.subtype ILIKE 'AU%%' THEN 'AU' WHEN z.subtype ILIKE 'U%%' THEN 'U' WHEN z.subtype = 'A' THEN 'A' WHEN z.subtype = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'autre' END AS fam, round((100 * sum(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(ST_MakeValid(z.geom_2975), p.g))) / NULLIF((SELECT a FROM p), 0))::numeric, 1) AS pct FROM spatial_layers z, p WHERE z.kind = 'plu_gpu_zone' AND ST_Intersects(z.geom_2975, p.g) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING sum(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(ST_MakeValid(z.geom_2975), p.g))) > 0 ORDER BY pct DESC

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE tier IN ('brulante', 'chaude', 'priorite', 'a_suivre')) FROM parcel_p_score_v2 WHERE run_id = %(run)s AND parcelle_id >= %(s)s AND parcelle_id < %(s)s || 'ÿ' AND left(parcelle_id, 10) = %(s)s
SELECT zone_fam, c100, c200, c100_recent, c100_acheve, voie10, voie75, bati10, bati30, bati75, assainissement_zonage FROM parcel_viabilisation WHERE idu = %(idu)s
SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE capa_dispo_mw<=0) sat, count(*) FILTER (WHERE capa_dispo_mw>0) dispo, count(geom) with_geom, max(source) src FROM grid_capacity

SELECT commune FROM parcels WHERE idu = %(idu)s

SELECT round(t.taux_non_racc)::int AS taux, t.millesime, sl.name AS nom FROM parcels p JOIN spatial_layers sl ON sl.kind = 'iris_insee' AND ST_Contains(sl.geom_2975, ST_Centroid(p.geom_2975)) JOIN anc_maille_taux t ON t.maille = 'iris' AND t.code = sl.subtype WHERE p.idu = %(idu)s LIMIT 1

SELECT count(DISTINCT commune) FROM parcels

SELECT max(surface_m2) surf, min(echeance) ech, bool_or(equipe) eq FROM parkings_aper WHERE idus @> to_jsonb(CAST(%(idu)s AS text)) AND tranche IS NOT NULL
SELECT to_regclass('parcel_renouvellement') IS NOT NULL

SELECT renouv_score, comp_potentiel, comp_assiette, comp_marche, code_bati_origine, sdp_residuelle_m2, sdp_nette_m2, contrainte_pct, surface_m2, zone_plu, commune, rang_segment, rang_commune, run_label, to_char(computed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS maj, (SELECT count(*) FROM parcel_renouvellement WHERE run_label = %(run)s) AS total_segment, (SELECT count(*) FROM parcel_renouvellement r2 WHERE r2.commune = parcel_renouvellement.commune AND r2.run_label = %(run)s) AS total_commune FROM parcel_renouvellement WHERE idu = %(idu)s AND run_label = %(run)s

SELECT p.commune, substring(min(p.idu) from 1 for 5) AS insee, count(*) AS parcelles, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.tier IN ('brulante', 'chaude', 'priorite', 'a_suivre')) AS chaudes, count(DISTINCT pm.siren) FILTER (WHERE s.tier IN ('brulante', 'chaude', 'priorite', 'a_suivre') AND pm.siren IS NOT NULL) AS dossiers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.tier IN ('brulante', 'chaude', 'priorite', 'a_suivre') AND pm.siren IS NULL) AS chaudes_sans_identite, count(s.parcelle_id) AS evaluees, ST_XMin(ST_Extent(p.geom)) AS x1, ST_YMin(ST_Extent(p.geom)) AS y1, ST_XMax(ST_Extent(p.geom)) AS x2, ST_YMax(ST_Extent(p.geom)) AS y2 FROM parcels p LEFT JOIN parcel_p_score_v2 s ON s.parcelle_id = p.idu AND s.run_id = %(run)s LEFT JOIN parcelle_personne_morale pm ON pm.idu = p.idu GROUP BY p.commune ORDER BY 4 DESC, 3 DESC

WITH base AS (SELECT DISTINCT left(idu, 5) AS insee, commune FROM parcels), stock AS ( SELECT left(s.parcelle_id, 5) AS insee, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.tier IN ('brulante', 'chaude', 'priorite', 'a_suivre')) AS n FROM parcel_p_score_v2 s WHERE s.run_id = %(run)s GROUP BY 1), velo AS ( SELECT commune, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delai_mois) AS mois, count(*) AS n FROM m10_permit_delais WHERE valide AND famille = 'logements' AND delai_mois >= 0 GROUP BY 1), permis AS ( SELECT commune, count(*) AS n FROM sitadel_permits WHERE date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 years') GROUP BY 1), sru AS (SELECT insee, greatest(objectif_pct - taux_lls, 0) AS deficit, statut FROM commune_contexte_sru), zan AS (SELECT insee, conso_2021_2024_m2 / 10000.0 AS ha FROM commune_conso_enaf) -- €/m² ANCIEN : SOURCE UNIQUE `prix_ancien_communes` (moteurs), mappée en Python (cf. _compute) — -- plus de CTE recopiée : le tableau Communes et le PDF baromètre lisent la MÊME fonction (§1b). -- RETOURS-11F M1 : le NEUF (prix_neuf) ne vient PLUS de `dvf_prix_sortie_neuf` (précalcul divergent — -- mesuré Saint-Paul 97415 : précalc 4 730 vs live 5 003) mais du MÊME moteur live `neuf_vefa_commune` -- que la fiche et la carte, calculé en Python dans `raw_rows` (fiche = table = carte, à l'euro près). SELECT b.insee, b.commune, stock.n AS stock, velo.mois AS velocite, velo.n AS velocite_n, permis.n AS permis, sru.deficit AS deficit_sru, sru.statut AS sru_statut, zan.ha AS pression_zan FROM base b LEFT JOIN stock ON stock.insee = b.insee LEFT JOIN velo ON velo.commune = b.commune LEFT JOIN permis ON permis.commune = b.commune LEFT JOIN sru ON sru.insee = b.insee LEFT JOIN zan ON zan.insee = b.insee ORDER BY b.commune;

SELECT commune, count(*) AS n, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY valeur_fonciere / NULLIF(surface_reelle_bati, 0)))::int AS median FROM dvf_mutations WHERE nature_mutation = 'Vente' AND valeur_fonciere > 1000 AND valeur_fonciere / NULLIF(surface_reelle_bati, 0) BETWEEN 100 AND 12000 GROUP BY commune HAVING count(*) >= %(mv)s

WITH mut AS ( SELECT id_mutation, max(valeur_fonciere) AS valeur, sum(COALESCE(surface_reelle_bati,0)) AS bati FROM dvf_mutations_parcelle WHERE code_commune = %(insee)s AND nature_mutation = 'Vente en l''état futur d''achèvement' AND date_mutation >= (now() - interval '5 years')::date GROUP BY id_mutation) SELECT count(*) AS n_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bati > 0 AND valeur > 1000 AND valeur/bati BETWEEN 50 AND 20000) AS n, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY valeur/bati) FILTER (WHERE bati > 0 AND valeur > 1000 AND valeur/bati BETWEEN 50 AND 20000) AS med FROM mut

WITH parc AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.id_mutation, m.id_parcelle, z.zone_fam, m.valeur_fonciere AS val, m.millesime AS mill, max(COALESCE(m.surface_terrain,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.id_mutation, m.id_parcelle) AS terr_parc FROM dvf_mutations_parcelle m JOIN parcels p ON p.idu = m.id_parcelle AND p.commune = %(c)s JOIN parcel_zone_plu z ON z.idu = m.id_parcelle WHERE m.nature_mutation = 'Vente' AND COALESCE(m.surface_reelle_bati,0) = 0 AND m.surface_terrain > 0 AND z.zone_fam IN ('U','AU')), tot AS (SELECT id_mutation, sum(terr_parc) AS terr_tot, max(val) AS val, max(mill) AS mill FROM parc GROUP BY id_mutation), muz AS (SELECT DISTINCT id_mutation, zone_fam FROM parc) SELECT muz.zone_fam, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tot.val / NULLIF(tot.terr_tot,0)) AS med, count(*) AS n, max(tot.mill) AS mill FROM muz JOIN tot USING (id_mutation) WHERE tot.terr_tot > 0 GROUP BY muz.zone_fam

WITH parc AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.id_mutation, m.id_parcelle, z.zone_fam, m.valeur_fonciere AS val, m.millesime AS mill, max(COALESCE(m.surface_terrain,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY m.id_mutation, m.id_parcelle) AS terr_parc FROM dvf_mutations_parcelle m JOIN parcels p ON p.idu = m.id_parcelle AND p.commune = %(c)s JOIN parcel_zone_plu z ON z.idu = m.id_parcelle WHERE m.nature_mutation = 'Vente' AND COALESCE(m.surface_reelle_bati,0) = 0 AND m.surface_terrain > 0 AND z.zone_fam IN ('U','AU')), tot AS (SELECT id_mutation, sum(terr_parc) AS terr_tot, max(val) AS val, max(mill) AS mill FROM parc GROUP BY id_mutation), muz AS (SELECT DISTINCT id_mutation, zone_fam FROM parc) SELECT muz.zone_fam, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tot.val / NULLIF(tot.terr_tot,0)) AS med, count(*) AS n, max(tot.mill) AS mill FROM muz JOIN tot USING (id_mutation) WHERE tot.terr_tot > 0 GROUP BY muz.zone_fam
